question: Should this PR require a redacted real WhatsApp/Gateway no-op run before merge, or may maintainers explicitly accept the mocked controller and Chromium proof as sufficient for this branch?
rationale: The patch cannot create a real configured WhatsApp environment itself, and the external-PR proof gate requires a maintainer choice when the available evidence is intentionally mock-based.

options.title: Require redacted live proof
options.body: Capture a configured Gateway returning the semantic no-op and the resulting preserved Control UI state, with account and endpoint details redacted.

options.title: Explicitly accept the mock-only exception
options.body: Record a maintainer proof override if the existing Gateway contract and mocked UI coverage are judged adequate for this narrowly scoped behavior.

recommendation.title: Require redacted live proof
recommendation.body: Capture a configured Gateway returning the semantic no-op and the resulting preserved Control UI state, with account and endpoint details redacted.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the submitted implementation and evidence and are the closest available person to provide or coordinate the requested runtime proof.
